caption: The video captures a long, flat white ice floe resting on the glassy surface of a calm turquoise lake. The floe carries a raised blocky hump at its left end and lies above a thinner, separate sliver of ice near its middle. A small dark stick-like protrusion pokes up close to its right-center edge. A soft mirror image of the entire formation shimmers directly beneath it, and vertical streaks of light stretch across the upper water. As the clip proceeds, the ice keeps its overall shape and remains largely steady, while the view shifts, the floe settling lower within it. The vertical light streaks spread wider along the top, and a darker horizontal band creeps into the upper edge. Ripples continuously waver across the water's mirror image as the ice itself stays broadly in place.
